item.title: Axsome Auvelity Alzheimer's Agitation
item.description:
• Summary: Axsome Therapeutics received FDA approval for Auvelity (dextromethorphan/bupropion) to treat agitation in patients with Alzheimer's disease. Following this nod, the company raised its peak‑year sales forecast for the drug to $8 billion. Auvelity is already approved for major depressive disorder, and this label expansion addresses a significant unmet need in Alzheimer's behavioral symptoms.
  • MoAs: Dextromethorphan: NMDA receptor antagonist and sigma‑1 receptor agonist; bupropion: norepinephrine‑dopamine reuptake inhibitor
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: Neurocrine Movement Disorder Diagnosis

  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: Quralis ALS Phase 2 Data
item.description:
• Summary: Quralis releases Phase 2 data that bolsters the case for a genetic approach to treating sporadic ALS, suggesting targeting specific genetic pathways.
  • MoAs: Investigational therapy targeting genetic factors in ALS, potentially reducing TDP-43 pathology.
  • Sources: BioSpace

item.title: Sertraline Recall UK
item.description:
• Summary: A manufacturer recalled a batch of the antidepressant sertraline (Zoloft) in the UK due to a packaging mix-up. The recall was precautionary, and no adverse events were reported. Sertraline is a commonly prescribed SSRI.
  • MoAs: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI)
  • Sources: BioSpace
